name: vllm_merge_attn_states
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_merge_attn_states.py. Merges prefix and suffix attention states using log-sum-exp stable merging; reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.merge_attn_states(output, prefix_output, prefix_lse, suffix_output, suffix_lse, output_lse=None) and writes merged result into the preallocated output buffer. Source parametrizes shapes (num_seqs, num_heads, head_dim) and dtype in {fp16,bf16,fp32}; migrated workloads use representative shapes from the test. LSE tensors are 2D float32, attention outputs are 3D. Requires vLLM at eval time.
